description: Pocket Coach rule registry. Formulas live in ClientIntake's calculations.js (src/intakeCalculations.js here); these rules hold the parameters, ranges and package layouts the plan generator feeds into them. Butters University is the evidence source: each rule's `bu` block names the README section and quotes that back it, and `buttersUniversity` pins the commit those quotes were checked at. A rule stays verified:false until a person has reviewed it and set it to true.
